ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.inventoryDate map (item, index) -> { Date: item, Elmendorf: vars.elmendorfIdpResponse[item], "TSAR": vars."tsarIdpResponse"[item], "TMS6": vars."tms6Data"[item], Freepoint: vars.freepointIdpResponse }
%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::core::Dates --- vars.completeSet orderBy (item) -> (item.Date as Date { format: "d-MMM-yyyy" })
%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::core::Dates --- vars.compltFreepointIdpResponse orderBy (item) -> (item."Inventory Date" as Date { format: "d-MMM-yyyy" })
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "Date": payload.Date, "Elmendorf": payload.Elmendorf, "TSAR": payload.TSAR, "TMS6": payload.TMS6, "Freepoint": payload.Freepoint }
